dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noFavoritesDescription: Star your containers or URLs in the management page to see them here.
dashboard.editModeDescription: Drag and drop shortcuts to reorder or move between sections.
dashboard.dockerNotRunningHint: Start Docker Desktop to see and manage your containers.

containers.title: Docker Containers
containers.noContainersDescription: Start some Docker containers to see them here.

hosts.title: Servers
hosts.description: Every Docker host this dashboard reads. Nothing of docker-dash is installed on the others: they are reached at their Docker API, over ssh or through a socket proxy.
hosts.name: Name
hosts.urlHint: ssh://user@machine (recommended: just sshd and a key), or tcp://machine:2375 for a socket proxy on a network you trust.
hosts.hostnameHint: Hostname used to open this server's containers by port, when its services are not published on the address above.
hosts.deleteConfirm: Remove "{{name}}"? Its shortcuts on this dashboard go with it. The server itself and its containers are left untouched.
hosts.legacyAgentDisabled: Switched off: it was read through the old agent. Edit it and give it an ssh:// or tcp:// address.

errors.no_url: This server has no address configured.
errors.bad_response: That server answered something unexpected. Is the address pointing at a Docker API?
errors.refused: Connection refused - nothing is listening on that address and port.
errors.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Check the address and any firewall.
errors.docker_down: Docker is not running on that server.
errors.legacy_agent: docker-dash no longer reads other dashboards. Use ssh://user@machine, or tcp://machine:2375 through a socket proxy.
errors.bad_url: The address must start with ssh://, tcp:// or unix://
errors.ssh_auth: The ssh key was not accepted. Authorise it on that machine with ssh-copy-id.
errors.ssh_host_key: That machine is not in known_hosts. Run ssh user@machine once from the machine docker-dash runs on and accept its key.
errors.no_docker_cli: docker is not on that user's PATH on the remote machine.
errors.socket_permission: That user cannot use Docker there. Add it to the docker group on the remote machine.
errors.forbidden: The socket proxy refused this. Give it CONTAINERS=1, and POST=1 to start and stop.
